name: Coriander Lime Tofu
ingredients: 250 g extra-firm tofu, pressed and sliced in slabs
Juice of 2 limes and zest of 1
steps: Blend the coriander, lime juice and zest, garlic, chilli, cumin and salt with 2 tbsp water into a loose marinade.
Coat the tofu slabs and marinate for 20 minutes.
Pan-sear in a non-stick pan with the oil for 4 minutes per side until golden.
Spoon over any remaining marinade and serve with salad.
note: Bright and fresh; pair with a grain or salad for a full meal.
